hook: Why Does Voice AI Still Struggle with Kenyans' Speech?
hookText: Why Does Voice AI Still Struggle with Kenyans' Speech?

beats.say: Voice AI still struggles with Kenyan speech, and the piece looks at why Swahili and local accents trip up today's systems.
The African Next Voices project, supported by a US $2.2 million Gates Foundation grant, has recorded 9,000 hours across 18 languages.

Google’s Waxal corpus, launched in February 2026, adds more than 11,000 hours across 21 African languages, Swahili included. A March 2026 preprint by a team including a Harvard University researcher reports a 3.24 percent word-error rate on recordings.
